title: Admin streamlet helpers: lightweight tasklets for runbooks-as-tasks
creator: Liam Chen
description: Build a small, composable set of "streamlet" helpers (lightweight tasklets) that make converting existing runbooks into idempotent, observable tasks easier for first-line support and automation. The goal is a minimal runtime shim plus a small library of canonical steps (query, patch, checkpoint, dry-run, safe-rollback) that integrate with the runbook orchestration layer and the ops telemetry pipeline. This ticket scopes the core API surface, a migration helper CLI, and an initial set of 6 canonical tasklets. We prioritize safety (preconditions, permission checks) and observability (traces, tokenized cost estimates) so teammates can adopt the pattern without bespoke engineering on each playbook.
acceptance_criteria: Core streamlet library published with 6 tasklets: query, apply-patch, checkpoint, dry-run, rollback, notify
Tasklets expose idempotent API and integrate with existing runbook executor via HTTP shim
Permission gating implemented: tasklets check RBAC tokens and fail safe when insufficient
Tracing and per-step telemetry emitted to ops-metrics with stable schema
Migration helper CLI (convert-runbook) can transform two example runbooks into streamlet manifests
Integration tests and canary run executed in staging with no regressions
